Messages.Body:

Messages.Body:

>>
>>If I use my Magnum .44 to maneuver to long range. Is it necessary to
>>use the Magnum for any additional strikes...

>You have to use the Magnum gun for the additional strikes.

You only have to use the Magnum for the first strike of the round.
Any additional strikes may be whatever you like (the Magnum again,
a Sewer Lid, Theft of Vitae, whatever).
